analysis.resume_summary: Aarav Sharma is a B.Tech Computer Science student at NIT Surathkal with strong full‑stack development experience. He has built AI‑enhanced recruitment platforms, high‑throughput task queues, and scalable microservice APIs using modern TypeScript, Python, and cloud technologies. His internship at NovaTech and multiple certifications demonstrate competence in cloud, containerization, and DevOps.

projects.name: CampusFlow Campus Recruitment Intelligence Platform
projects.description: Architected a university placement platform serving students, recruiters, and placement directors with AI‑driven resume parsing and real‑time interview scheduling.
projects.impact: Integrated Groq LPU engine for automatic skill taxonomy extraction and automated calendar sync; platform enables role‑based access control across multiple user types.

projects.name: Distributed Task Queue & Event Processor
projects.description: Built an asynchronous distributed background task processor capable of handling up to 10,000 tasks per minute with exponential backoff retries and Pub/Sub event broadcasting.
projects.impact: Provided high‑throughput processing with observability via Prometheus metrics.

projects.name: Cloud Commerce Scalable Microservices API
projects.description: Engineered decoupled REST API microservices with JWT authentication, rate limiting, and ACID‑compliant transactions.
projects.impact: Optimized query plans and indexes, reducing average p95 latency by 42%.

responsibilities: Developed enterprise microservices using TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL for customer analytics.
Automated unit and integration test coverage to 92% with Jest and Supertest across 14 API endpoints.
Collaborated on AWS ECS container deployments and performed database indexing improvements.

recommended_roles.why: Aarav has demonstrated end‑to‑end development of web applications (React/TypeScript front‑end, Node.js/Express back‑end) and integration of databases and cloud services, matching core full‑stack responsibilities.
missing_competencies: Advanced testing frameworks (Cypress/Playwright)
State‑management beyond Redux (e.g., Zustand)
CI/CD pipelines with Terraform or Kubernetes
recommended_roles.suggested_next_steps: Add end‑to‑end UI tests with Cypress, explore container orchestration (Kubernetes) and IaC (Terraform) to strengthen deployment expertise.

recommended_roles.why: The candidate’s experience building high‑throughput task queues, microservice APIs, and database optimizations aligns with backend engineering focus on performance and scalability.
missing_competencies: Deep expertise in Go or Rust for systems‑level services
Experience with message brokers like Kafka
recommended_roles.suggested_next_steps: Learn Go or Rust basics and experiment with Kafka or RabbitMQ to broaden backend toolkit.

recommended_roles.why: Aarav holds AWS Cloud Practitioner and Docker certifications, has deployed services on AWS ECS, and uses Docker containers, indicating readiness for cloud‑focused roles.
missing_competencies: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
Kubernetes orchestration
Serverless architecture beyond Lambda (e.g., Step Functions)
recommended_roles.suggested_next_steps: Complete a Terraform certification and build a Kubernetes‑based deployment pipeline for a personal project.

strengths: Proven ability to design and deliver end‑to‑end full‑stack systems with AI integration.
Experience with high‑throughput asynchronous architectures and performance optimization.
skill_gaps: Limited exposure to advanced UI testing frameworks (Cypress, Playwright).
No hands‑on experience with Kubernetes or Terraform for infrastructure automation.
Lack of Go or Rust experience for low‑level backend services.
improvement_suggestions: Add end‑to‑end testing using Cypress or Playwright to strengthen frontend reliability.
Learn Kubernetes and Terraform to enable production‑grade cloud deployments.
Explore Go or Rust to diversify backend language expertise.
